profile.headline: Software Developer Associate at PNC
profile.summary: I am a hardworking and driven individual who strives to be better and make others around me better. I have strong analytical and interpersonal skills, and these make me highly adaptable to various situations while producing desired results. Continuously problem solving is my jam.

volunteerExperiences.description: I would be assigned a student with disabilities, and I would take them to their events and encourage them throughout the day,

I had to design a summer camp for kids who could not afford it. We had to make an English lessons, outdoor and indoor games, and arts and crafts. I also went out to the community, and built latrines and help rebuild houses.
